manual_review.old_text: Default routeeigentlich vollständig: Prefix-lenght+ZielHere’s how routers make routing decisions, in order: Prefix length (longest match wins) → Router always prefers the most specific route (e.g., /32 over /24). Administrative distance (AD) → If multiple routes to the same prefix exist from different sources (e.g., OSPF vs. EIGRP), the one with the lowest AD is chosen. Metric → If multiple routes to the same prefix exist within the same protocol, the one with the lowest metric is chosen. Default route → Used only when no more specific route exists.
